profile.headline: Software Engineer at NETSCOUT

company.name: Arbor Networks, now part of NETSCOUT

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
• Configured, deployed, and modified the distributed sensing and control environment VOLTTRON.
• Implemented health-monitoring on a production-scale deployment and diagnosed results with senior colleague.
• Reviewed academic works and documentation deliverables .
• Brainstormed the design of a transactive control system for energy utilization.
• Worked extensively in a networked, linux environment; Trobleshot varied issues with common linux tools.

company.name: The University of Toledo College of Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Developed features of the network visualization and DDoS mitigation software Arbor Sightline.
• Practiced Agile Development as a software engineer, emphasizing collaboration, engineering documentation,  .
• Completed feature and debug work including design and engineering judgement.
• Worked on  an API, build systems (Bash), distributed database, documentation, and some front-end (PHP), back-end (C), and used various in-house and third-party tools.
• Developed for a complex, Linux-based environment to create a reliable and featured.

company.name: Arbor Networks, the security division of NETSCOUT

positions.title: Software Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
• Automated a microdevice probing tool including a graphical interface to address current use cases.
• Expanded the plant’s SCADA and facilities alarm system.
• Improved HVAC system to allow overnight power savings.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Worked under Dr. Randall Ellingson to:
• Contribute weather and solar data to the National Renewable Energy Laboratory.
• Design, sourced, and installed a sensor system for the research center’s solar array.
• Design a printed circuit board and circuits.
